title: Classify search-term intent before zero-conversion cuts
item: One search term from a zero-conversion sweep
questions: choice:intent - navigational_to_self, research_comparison, transactional, brand_name_defense, other; noul:exempt_purpose - is this term from a campaign run for non-conversion purposes
action: Code filters by status and tracking health first; navigational_to_self at high confidence goes to the cut list, transactional is protected, the rest queue for review
why_jev: The SOP says classify by intent not cost; a street address versus a competitor name is semantic and runs across thousands of terms per account
doctrine: Classify each zero-conversion candidate by intent (navigational, research, transactional), not just cost

title: Protect converting terms from a negative list
item: One candidate negative keyword against the converting-term list
questions: noul:blocks_converter - would this negative (with its match type) block any listed converting query; choice:risk - safe, risky, unclear
action: Code applies match-type semantics deterministically; Jev flags semantically adjacent converters (plural, synonym) that string match misses; risky ones get dropped from the add-list
why_jev: Protect-before-block needs a fuzzy "is this the same thing a patient converted on"; BROAD negatives hide near-synonym collisions that code cannot see
doctrine: Pull converting terms and test the candidate negatives against them before attaching

title: Read a canned negative list for terms we want
item: One term inside an imported shared negative list
questions: noul:wanted_term - would a medical/aesthetic practice want traffic for this term; choice:category - service_intent, jobs, diy, free, competitor, informational, other
action: Terms flagged wanted are listed for removal before the list is attached to the money campaign
why_jev: A 100+ term canned list gets read by nobody; per-term judgment against the practice's services is cheap and exhaustive
doctrine: Read canned lists before importing; they routinely contain terms you want

title: Out-of-area place name search term
item: One search term from a Presence-targeted campaign
questions: noul:out_of_area_place - does the query name a place outside the service area; choice:place_type - city, region, landmark, none
action: Code holds the service-area list; flagged terms become keyword negatives since geo exclusions cannot reach them
why_jev: Geo exclusions act on physical location, so out-of-area query content needs keyword negatives; spotting a place name inside free text is a classification
doctrine: Step 6: location exclusions never act on query content; that needs a keyword negative

title: Stale claim sweep across ad assets
item: One ad asset text line (headline, description, sitelink, callout)
questions: choice:claim_type - accreditation, credential, trademark, superlative, drug_name, price_offer, none; noul:needs_substantiation - is a verifiable claim made
action: Assets with a claim type route to compliance with the asset ID; link status resolved in code to avoid false positives on replaced RSA text
why_jev: The SOP wants partial-stem text search over every surface; a classifier reads each line instead of fragile regex stems
doctrine: Sweep ad copy for stale claims across all asset surfaces

title: Policy topic: destination or ad copy
item: One policy_topic_entries evidence record
questions: choice:locus - landing_page_content, ad_copy, account_certification, other; noul:account_level - does this read as an account-wide finding
action: Account-level hits are reported once to compliance; destination hits go to the landing-page owner, not to ad editing
why_jev: Near-universal APPROVED_LIMITED must be recognized as one account finding rather than N ad fixes, a pattern judgment over many rows
doctrine: Step 7: read evidence type; destination text means rewriting the ad achieves nothing

title: Is this campaign really live
item: One campaign row with status, serving_status, experiment_type, name
questions: choice:state - live, ended_experiment_arm, paused_equivalent, brand_protection, gbp_ctr, unclear
action: Code scopes only live campaigns and applies standing exemptions; unclear rows go to the strategist
why_jev: Campaign names and experiment fields mixed together need judgment about exempt purpose (GBP CTR, brand protection) that names alone reveal
doctrine: Count only what can serve; subtract known non-conversion exemptions before sorting

title: Auto-triage Google Ads recommendations
item: One Google Ads recommendation from list_recommendations
questions: choice:action - apply, dismiss, review; noul:conflicts_doctrine - does it conflict with bidding-strategy doctrine (e.g. bid adjustments on Smart Bidding)
action: Dismiss at high confidence, queue the rest in a weekly review
why_jev: Recommendations arrive in volume weekly; the SOP warns manual-bidding advice is a no-op on Smart Bidding, which a classifier can gate on
doctrine: Step 3: gate the doctrine on the bidding strategy

title: Standing-decision relitigation check
item: A newly proposed change against recorded standing decisions
questions: noul:already_decided - does a standing decision with an anti-relitigation note cover this proposal
action: Matches surface the old note instead of reopening the debate
why_jev: Standing decisions are stored as prose; matching a new proposal to an old rationale is semantic lookup, and re-arguing it costs analyst time every cycle
doctrine: Record standing decisions with anti-relitigation notes

title: Classify search terms for PPC validation keyword derivation
item: One converting search term
questions: choice:intent - service_specific, near_me_local, brand, competitor, informational, other; noul:viable_seo_keyword - is it a keyword a page could own
action: Terms that pass are grouped as candidate SEO targets derived from what actually converted
why_jev: The SOP derives the keyword from converting terms; grouping near-duplicate phrasings by intent is a cheap per-term call
doctrine: Derive the SEO keyword from converting search terms before committing effort

title: Shadow-page message match for PPC validation
item: An ad headline plus shadow-page H1 and first paragraph
questions: score:message_match - 1 to 5 scent match; noul:promise_gap - does the page fail to deliver what the ad promises
action: Low scores block the test start and return the gap to the builder
why_jev: Validation results are meaningless if the shadow page does not match the ad; checking before spend saves a 30-day test
doctrine: Validate audience, message and keyword in PPC before committing SEO effort

title: Route a search term to a quick-win campaign type
item: One search term or competitor query
questions: choice:win_type - branded, dsa, near_me, gbp_informed, smart_via_gbp, none
action: Terms bucket into the five quick-win lists for campaign building
why_jev: The five quick-win types are a five-way menu; sorting a keyword list into buckets is classic bulk sort
doctrine: The five quick-win campaign types: branded, DSA, near-me, GBP-informed, Smart via GBP

title: Branded versus competitor-brand term check
item: One term proposed for the Branded campaign
questions: choice:brand_type - own_brand, provider_name, competitor_brand, generic; noul:trademark_risk - does it use a third-party trademark
action: Own brand stays; competitor brands are held for the policy decision
why_jev: Branded campaigns silently pick up competitor names; a per-term check keeps the exact-match list clean
doctrine: Branded win must contain only the practice's own brand terms

title: DSA page-feed fit
item: One site URL with title and H1 for a DSA page feed
questions: choice:page_role - service, location, blog, legal, utility, other; noul:ad_worthy - would a paid click on it make sense
action: Only ad-worthy service and location pages join the DSA target list
why_jev: DSA targets URLs; excluding blog, privacy and careers pages by meaning beats URL regex on irregular sites
doctrine: Dynamic Search Ads target the right pages

title: Audience observation segment relevance
item: One in-market or affinity audience segment label
questions: choice:relevance - core_buyer, adjacent, funnel_entry, irrelevant
action: Core and adjacent segments added in observation mode; irrelevant dropped
why_jev: Hundreds of segment labels per account; the SOP wants adjacency and funnel-entry mapping done by meaning
doctrine: Observation-before-targeting with adjacency and funnel-entry mapping

title: Call transcript intent mining
item: One call-transcript snippet (text only)
questions: choice:caller_intent - new_patient_booking, price_shopping, existing_patient, wrong_number, vendor_spam, other; noul:contains_new_objection
action: Counts feed audience and copy decisions; new objections go to the strategist
why_jev: Call-transcript mining is described as manual; per-call labels make the funnel quality measurable without reading each call
doctrine: Mine call transcripts for audience and message signals

title: Throttling diagnosis signal
item: A campaign's audience-size and impression-share summary line
questions: choice:diagnosis - audience_too_narrow, budget_limited, bid_limited, targeting_ok, insufficient_data
action: Narrow-audience verdicts loosen the targeting before any bid work
why_jev: Observation-before-targeting means distinguishing throttling from poor demand; metrics are computed by code, the verdict is a label

title: Device or location report row to SEO action
item: One row from a device/day/location/demographic paid report
questions: choice:action_type - seo_content, site_ux, landing_page, ignore; noul:actionable_for_site - is the finding something the website can act on
action: Actionable rows are listed in the monthly insights sheet with their routed owner
why_jev: The SOP's loop is paid report to organic action; deciding which rows are actionable by meaning avoids an analyst reading all of them
doctrine: Mine paid reports into SEO, site and content actions

title: PMax search-term category theme
discipline: PPC Data Mining for SEO and Site
item: One PMax search term
questions: choice:theme - service, symptom, brand, location, competitor, junk; noul:new_to_seo_plan
action: Themes cluster into content gaps compared to the current topical map
why_jev: PMax terms are the cheapest source of real query language; labeling them at volume feeds the content plan
doctrine: Mine PMax terms and scale winners by duplication

title: Scale-by-duplication readiness
item: A campaign performance summary plus its settings notes
questions: noul:ready_to_duplicate - does this campaign show a stable winner per the duplication criteria
action: Ready ones queue for a duplicate-and-test ticket
why_jev: Duplicating a campaign is a spend decision; Jev pre-sorts which accounts to look at first
doctrine: Scale a winner by duplicating rather than raising budget

title: Hygiene checklist item match to account setting
item: One account setting note from the 10-point hygiene baseline
questions: choice:status - compliant, noncompliant, not_applicable, insufficient_context
action: Noncompliant items become tasks; insufficient_context sends the item to the strategist
why_jev: The 10-point baseline is repeated on every inherited account; per-setting verdicts parallelize across accounts

title: Conversion action sanity check
item: One conversion action name, category, and source
questions: choice:type - real_lead, micro_engagement, duplicate_counter, test_or_junk; noul:inflates_counts
action: Duplicates and junk are listed before any performance judgment is made on the account
why_jev: Step 2 says verify measurement before judging anything; conversion actions are named inconsistently and classification by meaning finds the junk
doctrine: Step 2: verify measurement before judging anything on it

title: Campaign naming to program mapping
item: One campaign name plus labels
questions: choice:program - branded, dsa, near_me, gbp_informed, pmax, validation, general, unknown
action: Mapping populates the account plan so the planner picks which routine is due
why_jev: Account naming is inconsistent across clients; mapping to the program menu lets the roster sweep run without manual inventory
doctrine: Decide which routine is due for each account

title: Past change vs hypothesis review
item: A change-history note and the later metric summary
questions: choice:outcome - confirmed, refuted, inconclusive, too_early
action: Refuted changes reopen the ticket; confirmed ones close the loop
why_jev: The conductor reviews past changes against hypotheses; short change notes against a metric summary are a quick verdict per item
doctrine: Review past changes against their hypotheses

title: Landing page checklist item scoring
item: One checklist item with the page's extracted element text
questions: choice:status - pass, partial, fail, not_present; score:strength - 1 to 5
action: Code sums per section; fails ranked by weight become the fix list
why_jev: A long checklist per page times many pages is the heaviest read in ads review; each item is atomic and the LLM only writes the final fixes
doctrine: Audit landing page against a landing page checklist plus ad-to-page message match

title: Ad-to-page message match gate
item: One ad headline set and the matching page H1 with first 50 words
questions: score:scent - 1 to 5 message match; noul:offer_mismatch - does the page offer something different from the ad
action: Pairs under 3 are queued for rewrite before more spend
why_jev: Message match is a pure semantic comparison across every ad group and page pair
doctrine: Ad-to-page scent audit for paid-traffic pages

title: Weekly account pass: is an anomaly worth a look
item: One account's weekly deltas as text lines
questions: choice:attention - urgent, review_this_week, normal; noul:needs_llm - needs the full optimization skill
action: Only flagged accounts invoke the expensive skill run
why_jev: Pre-filtering the roster before running a long optimisation skill avoids spending LLM time on calm accounts
doctrine: Daily/weekly/monthly optimisation pass producing a change list

title: Disapproval cause triage
item: One ad disapproval reason text
questions: choice:cause - healthcare_cert, trademark, misleading_claim, destination, formatting, other
action: Routes to compliance, copy or landing-page owner
why_jev: A fixed menu of causes with different owners; routing by cause saves a human triage pass
doctrine: Step 7: report policy findings once at the right altitude with the correct owner

title: Cannibalization risk: blog versus procedure page
item: A blog draft's title, H1, primary keyword and the procedure page's title and H1
questions: choice:overlap - distinct, partial, duplicate; noul:competes_for_head_term
action: Duplicate or competes yields a hard BLOCK before any other grading
why_jev: This hard block is a semantic overlap test between two titles and keyword sets; a cheap early gate saves drafting an entire post
doctrine: Blog must target informational long-tail intent distinct from the money page head term

title: Terminology split in sibling-page head terms
item: One sentence or heading containing a sibling page's head term
questions: choice:role - anchor_to_sibling, competing_in_prose, heading_use, none
action: Competing uses go on the fix list with line numbers
why_jev: The check is grep plus judgment on where each hit sits; Jev handles per-hit context cheaply
doctrine: Penalize sibling head term appearing in this draft's title/H1/body; fine in anchors

title: Medical claim without citation
item: One sentence from a medical blog draft
questions: noul:medical_claim - does the sentence assert a clinical or efficacy fact; noul:has_citation_or_attribution - does it carry a citation or named-surgeon attribution
action: Claims without support are flagged for the writer, hard block count increments
why_jev: This hard block needs a per-sentence classification across 1,000+ words; code can detect links, Jev detects the claim
doctrine: Medical claim with no citation and no named-surgeon attribution is a hard block

title: Patient story composite flag
item: One paragraph that may contain an anecdote
questions: noul:patient_story - is this a patient anecdote; noul:flagged_composite - does it state it is a composite
action: Unflagged stories block as potential PHI
why_jev: PHI risk is the highest-severity hard block and a story-detection call is quick
doctrine: PHI present or patient story not flagged as composite

title: FTC typicality qualifier check
item: One sentence describing a result or testimonial
questions: noul:implies_typical_result - does it imply the outcome is typical; noul:has_qualifier - is a results-vary qualifier present
action: Unqualified typical results hard-block and go to the compliance fix list
why_jev: A hard block; implication of typicality is subtle and varies in wording
doctrine: FTC: a result implied as typical without a qualifier

title: FDA status claim detection
item: One sentence in a draft
questions: noul:fda_status_claim - does it assert an FDA approved, cleared or not-approved status
action: Detected sentences are routed to a human compliance check with the product name
why_jev: This hard block is a regulated claim; Jev finds every occurrence so the human checks only those
doctrine: FDA status claim inaccurate or unverifiable is a hard block

title: Citation upgrade-word check
item: A claim sentence paired with the cited source's relevant sentence
questions: choice:support - supports_as_stated, weaker_than_claimed, unrelated, contradicts
action: Weaker or unrelated becomes a hard block with the downgrade wording suggested to the writer
why_jev: The skill says this is harder to catch than an invented stat because the link checks out; a pairwise support judgment is exactly the classifier shape
doctrine: Open the source and confirm it states the specific claim; watch for upgrade words

title: Orphan pronoun scan
item: One sentence
questions: noul:orphan_pronoun - does a pronoun lack a named entity antecedent
action: Hit lines are cited in the checklist
why_jev: The checklist requires every claim anchored to a named entity; sentence-level check across the draft

title: Query-aligned heading check
item: One H2 or H3 heading with the primary keyword
questions: score:query_alignment - 1 to 5 how well it matches a patient search; choice:form - question, noun_phrase, branded_cute, other
action: Low scores are listed in the fix list
why_jev: Patient-search alignment is semantic

title: Section atomicity check
item: One section of body copy
questions: noul:single_idea - does the section cover exactly one idea; choice:topic_count - one, two, three_plus
action: Multi-idea sections get a split recommendation
why_jev: Chunk extractability, evaluated per section

title: Answer-ready passage detection
item: One paragraph
questions: noul:standalone_answer - could this be lifted as a complete standalone snippet; noul:needs_context - does it depend on neighboring text
action: Pages with zero answer-ready passages fail the answer-ready check
why_jev: Cheap per-paragraph check across every draft

title: Avoidance framing detector
item: One sentence
questions: choice:frame - positive_active, negative_credibility, passive_impersonal, avoidance_other
action: Non-positive sentences listed for rewrite
why_jev: The checklist includes negative-frame credibility such as "not every surgeon does X"; a regex misses these
doctrine: Positive active constructions; no avoidance framing

title: Anti-AI phrase second pass
item: One sentence
questions: noul:ai_tell - does it read as stock AI phrasing; choice:tell_type - inflated_significance, rule_of_three, vague_attribution, hedging, none
action: Flagged lines go to the humanize pass before the blind gate
why_jev: The banned list is a fixed set but real tells paraphrase; a classifier catches variants the list misses

title: Reading level screen
item: One paragraph
questions: choice:reading_level - below_8th, 8th_to_10th, above_10th
action: Paragraphs above 10th flagged for simplification
why_jev: Code can compute a formula grade, but jargon density is semantic; both are combined
doctrine: Reading level 8th to 10th grade for YMYL

title: Client voice lexicon match
item: One paragraph with the client's voice sample excerpts as state
questions: score:lexicon_fit - 1 to 5; noul:generic_medical_synonyms - uses generic terms instead of the client's vocabulary
action: Low scores feed a voice deduction, not a block
why_jev: Voice items score the fit against a reference; paragraph-by-paragraph scoring is cheap

title: Authority-register hedge placement
item: One hedged sentence
questions: choice:hedge_target - technique_or_judgment, patient_outcome, neither
action: Hedges on technique flagged; outcome hedges are protected
why_jev: The checklist requires outcome hedges but not technique hedges for authoritative clients; classification by what the hedge attaches to

title: Hook names a specific fear or desire
item: The first two paragraphs
questions: noul:specific_fear_or_desire - does the hook name a specific fear or desire; noul:question_opener
action: Failures logged under the hook check
why_jev: This is a mechanical-feeling but semantic check at the draft's start
doctrine: Hook enters the conversation already in the reader's mind

title: Proof device specificity
item: One proof sentence
questions: score:specificity - 1 to 5 how specific and believable; choice:device - named_provider, number, credential, vague
action: Vague proof flagged
why_jev: The check asks if belief is earned in text; scoring each proof line is cheap
doctrine: Proof devices are specific and believable

title: CTA risk-reduction check
item: The closing CTA paragraph
questions: noul:reason_to_act_now; noul:reduces_risk; noul:names_next_step
action: Missing elements listed
why_jev: The check has three atomic parts
doctrine: CTA gives a reason to act now and reduces risk

title: Headline option labelling check
item: One headline option with its claimed 4 U's labels
questions: choice:u_present - useful, urgent, unique, ultra_specific, none; noul:label_accurate
action: Mislabelled options fixed
why_jev: Accurate labels are required; mismatches are semantic
doctrine: 3 to 5 headline options with 4 U's labels

title: Pull quote paraphrase check
item: A pull quote and the nearest body sentence
questions: noul:verbatim_lift - is it copied rather than paraphrased
action: Lifted quotes flagged for rewriting
why_jev: Paraphrase detection is a similarity judgment; cheaper than the LLM reading both
doctrine: Pull quotes paraphrased rather than lifted

title: Keyword stuffing versus variation
item: Paragraph one plus keyword occurrences
questions: choice:keyword_use - natural_variation, exact_repeat_stuffing, absent
action: Stuffing fails the keyword check same as omission
why_jev: Code finds hits; Jev judges whether they are natural variations
doctrine: Primary keyword in first paragraph with natural variations

title: Is this list list-shaped content
item: One bulleted list and surrounding text
questions: noul:list_shaped - is the content genuinely a list; noul:prose_collapse - should this be a paragraph
action: Splits scoring between the list-presence and prose-collapse checks
why_jev: The skill explicitly asks for independent scoring of floor and ceiling; list shape is a semantic call
doctrine: At least one list; but prose must not collapse into bullet dumps

title: Pre-filter drafts before the blind copy review
item: A full draft's summary stats and the top hard-block questions
questions: noul:likely_block - does a quick pass show any hard-block trigger; choice:readiness - clearly_fails, borderline, likely_clean
action: Clearly failing drafts return to the writer without spending a full blind LLM review
why_jev: The full gate is an expensive full-rubric LLM re-grade; a cheap pre-pass avoids reviewing drafts that fail on obvious grounds
doctrine: Independent blocking gate re-grading drafts against the full rubric

title: Study sourcing relevance
item: A cited study title and abstract versus the sentence citing it
questions: choice:fit - supports, tangential, unrelated
action: Unrelated routes to fact-checker
why_jev: Study-sourcing checks need claim-source pairing; abstract-level pairing is a quick pass

title: Claim extraction filter for fact-checker
item: One sentence
questions: noul:checkable_claim - could this sentence be false; choice:claim_type - credential, nap, statistic, study, url, procedure_fact, superlative, none
action: Only checkable claims enter the retrieval loop
why_jev: Extraction is the first step and over-extraction wastes retrieval; per-sentence typing is cheap

title: Which source authority applies to a claim
item: One claim
questions: choice:source - client_yaml, gbp, named_source, paper, url_fetch, manufacturer, medical_source, none
action: Code picks the retrieval tool from the source choice
why_jev: The skill has a table mapping claim types to sources; routing is a menu pick
doctrine: Order of preference for source authority by claim type

title: Source mentions claim or only container
item: A claim and a retrieved source passage
questions: choice:verdict - verified, unverified, contradicted, unverifiable
action: High-confidence verified and contradicted pass through; the rest go to the LLM fact-checker
why_jev: The skill's key rule is that a source not mentioning the claim does not verify it; a pairwise entailment check filters easy cases
doctrine: A source that doesn't mention the claim does not verify it

title: Superlative detector
item: One sentence
questions: noul:superlative_or_only_first - does it use best, only, first, leading or similar
action: Hits flagged near-unverifiable and routed to rewrite
why_jev: Superlatives are near-unverifiable and ABA/FTC risk; word lists miss paraphrases
doctrine: Superlatives, only, first are near-unverifiable by nature

title: Provider credential format check
item: One provider mention in copy
questions: choice:format - dr_only, credential_string_only, both_dr_and_credential, other
action: Both-format cases get fixed per the provider-naming rule
why_jev: The checklist forbids "Dr." with a credential string; mixed formats vary
doctrine: Dr. is never combined with a credential string

title: Press release newsworthiness hook
item: A proposed press release brief
questions: choice:hook - timeliness, proximity, prominence, human_interest, significance, novelty, conflict, none; noul:hook_in_first_sentence
action: Zero hooks stops the SOP and sends to the client for a real hook
why_jev: The first step is a newsworthiness gate; the answer determines whether anyone writes anything
doctrine: At least one of seven news hooks must be stateable in the first sentence

title: Press release compliance early flag
item: The proposed hook and brief
questions: choice:risk - superlative, efficacy_claim, patient_story, guaranteed_outcome, none
action: Flag to vertical compliance now instead of at the draft gate
why_jev: The SOP says early flagging reduces wasted drafting time

title: Press release grader critical failures
item: One press release sentence or section
questions: choice:style_issue - first_person, list_or_bullets, question, promotional_tone, none
action: Critical failures pre-filter before the full grader
why_jev: The grader is mostly style rules; Jev pre-filters and the grader LLM finishes only the survivors
doctrine: Third-person objective tone, no lists, bullets or questions

title: Press release quote naturalness
item: One client quote
questions: score:human_voice - 1 to 5 sounds like a human said it; noul:corporate_language
action: Low scores sent back for rewrite
why_jev: A press release rule on quotes; classification of corporate polish is semantic
doctrine: Quotes sound like a human said them

title: Specifics beat adjectives check
item: One sentence
questions: noul:vague_adjective_claim - does it rely on an adjective in place of a specific; choice:specific_type - number, name, date, none
action: Weak lines listed for rewrite
why_jev: A press release rule applied across the whole release

title: Anchor text safety for press release links
item: One anchor text with the target URL type
questions: choice:anchor_type - brand, naked_url, money_exact_match, generic, topical; noul:money_anchor
action: Money-anchor hits are changed before distribution
why_jev: Internal links must use non-money anchors; classifying anchors is a standard call
doctrine: Internal links 2-3 with non-money anchor text

title: Distribution channel subtractions
item: The release and client vertical
questions: choice:subtract - drop_wire_x, drop_social, drop_local_media, keep_all
action: Defaults apply minus the chosen subtractions
why_jev: Step 4 is defaults plus subtractions; choice lookup
doctrine: Choose distribution channels: defaults plus subtractions

title: Press release follow-up repurpose fit
item: A published release
questions: choice:repurpose - blog, gbp_post, social, newsletter, none
action: Routes the repurpose task
why_jev: Step 7 repurposing is a menu pick per release

title: Blog topic fits procedure page
item: A proposed blog topic and the client's page list
questions: choice:supports_page - page_id from the list or none; noul:informational_intent
action: Topics with no supported page are rejected before drafting
why_jev: The pipeline requires every blog to serve a procedure page; the match is a catalog lookup against the page list
doctrine: Every blog serves a procedure page and never competes with it

title: Blog topic YMYL check
item: A proposed topic or heading
questions: noul:ymyl_sensitive - does it make medical claims requiring YMYL review; choice:review_level - standard, elevated
action: Elevated topics get the mandatory YMYL check earlier
why_jev: YMYL check is mandatory; flagging early focuses reviewers
doctrine: YMYL check mandatory for blog posts

title: Blog brief to copywriter routing
item: A task brief
questions: choice:route - blog_writer, service_page_copywriter, email_writer, gbp_post_writer, press_release_writer, none
action: The right writing skill is invoked automatically
why_jev: A writing workflow's first step routes writing tasks; a menu with an escape is classic routing
doctrine: Route write tasks to the correct writing skill

title: Segment which draft needs fact-check priority
item: A draft's claim density summary
questions: choice:priority - high, normal, low
action: High-priority drafts run the fact-checker before the copy review
why_jev: Both gates are expensive; ordering by risk saves effort
doctrine: Run fact-checker alongside the blind review gate on every draft

title: Newsletter section compliance
item: One newsletter block
questions: noul:fabricated_looking - does it include unsourced numbers or quotes; noul:unsubscribe_present - for the footer
action: Hits fail the newsletter copy review profile
why_jev: Zero-fabrication and CAN-SPAM rules are checklist items that fit atomic checks

title: Newsletter spec route selection
item: The month's content items
questions: choice:section - feature, tip, news, promo, patient_education, skip
action: Items sorted into the per-client spec
why_jev: Per-client spec dictates sections; item-to-section sorting

title: GBP post medical promotional language
item: One draft GBP post
questions: choice:language - compliant, promotional_claim, offer_with_price, health_claim, before_after; noul:suspension_risk
action: Risky posts are held for compliance before posting
why_jev: The SOP lists medical promotional language triggers that cause suspension; fast gate per post

title: GBP post topic freshness
item: A proposed GBP post versus the last 12 posts
questions: choice:overlap - distinct, similar, duplicate
action: Duplicates rejected so cadence content stays varied
why_jev: GBP posts go out monthly; avoiding repeats is a similarity call

title: Review response HIPAA discipline
item: A draft reply to a review
questions: noul:confirms_patient_relationship - does the reply confirm the reviewer is a patient or reveal treatment; noul:phi_present
action: Violations block the reply and trigger a rewrite
why_jev: HIPAA review-response discipline is a hard rule; a gate protects every response
